veranderings.rede: Under the AWS 2017, 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb ('neem jy', 'speel jy'), so it takes a comma.
'Ná' meaning 'after' takes the acute accent so that it is not read as 'na' (towards).
'Op plekke' is the idiom for 'here and there', so the definition can be misread; 'op verskillende plekke' says what is meant.
